notes.title: Serbian Games Week: Discounts, New Bundle and Our Next Game!
notes.notes:
We’re part of Serbian Games Week! Discover awesome games at a discount all week long.
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SerbianGamesWeek2025


[h2]Serbian Games Week[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SerbianGamesWeek2025]Serbian Games Week[/url] - over 120 titles on the Steam sale event featuring Serbian games

From Monday, September 22, gamers around the world will have the opportunity to browse, buy, or wishlist games made in Serbia. Some of over 120 games will be heavily discounted, while others will soon be published.

[url=https://sga.rs/?snr=1_614_615_serbiangamesweek2025_1601]The Serbian Games Association[/url] (SGA) has curated and launched Serbian Games Week, seven days of promotion and celebration of the success of the Serbian gaming ecosystem on Steam. 

There are more than 120 games on the list. It includes a wide variety of titles: from action, strategy and adventure, AA and indie projects, to games inspired by Slavic mythology. The search for the perfect game is made easier through categories and filters by genre.

Five games were singled out in the Epic Experiences category. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753900/The_King_is_Watching/]The King is Watching[/url], a new title from the publisher tinyBuild, is a roguelite kingdom-building game in which the player rules with the power of their gaze. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029780/Going_Medieval/]Going Medieval[/url], by the indie team Foxy Voxel, is a cozy city builder simulator with, as the word itself suggests, a medieval theme. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/588030/Derail_Valley/]DerailValley[/url] is the title of the studio Altfuture, a train driving simulator through beautiful, but also challenging landscapes. Entertainment Forge is behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043260/Gladiator_Guild_Manager/]Gladiator Guild Manager[/url], a strategic autobattle simulation of gladiators fighting. Fifth in this section is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1525700/Tavern_Master/]Tavern Master[/url] by Untitled Studio, another simulation set in the Middle Ages, but in this one, you build your perfect inn.

Serbian Games Week will last from September 22nd to 29th.


[h1]Our Next Game[/h1]
Don’t forget to wishlist and follow our newest title, Dreadwoods Gatekeeper! A complete visual overhaul and demo are coming soon.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Dreadwoods Gatekeeper (Our New Game), and a Free Game!
notes.notes:
Puzzle Chambers is now free for 5 days (Sept 14–19), so be sure to pick it up and share with your friends!

[h1]Dreadwoods Gatekeeper[/h1]

Our newest game is in development and getting close to its first demo. Be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/]Wishlist and Follow[/url] to get notified:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/]Dreadwoods Gatekeeper[/url] is a medieval fantasy gatekeeping simulation. You’ll become a gatekeeper in a small town rumored to have a monster. Manage the gate, inspect wagons, make decisions, meet townsfolk, patrol, and protect yourself.

We’re working hard on the first demo and recreating all the visuals (the current trailer is just a placeholder to give you the idea). In the meantime, here’s a small sneak peek at new characters and environments:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31146872/d7fb264e15a8248bfcdd5ffe2b6f8999e7fadc26.gif[/img]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/RjXjQveAwZ]Discord[/url] to be the first to try the early demo and share your feedback to help shape the final game!
[url=https://discord.gg/RjXjQveAwZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31146872/4c4cc6304d503a033e1217ce8e4094be1c96eb7e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: New Game: Medieval Fantasy Gatekeeping Sim + Puzzle Chambers Free Limited Time
notes.notes:
[p]Hi! Our first Steam game, Puzzle Chambers, will be free from September 14–19!
[/p][p]Also, our latest game, Gladiator Guild Manager, will be at an all-time low of 67% off starting September 14![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043260/Gladiator_Guild_Manager/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][h1]New Game: Dreadwoods Gatekeeper[/h1][p]And I wanted to share the game we’re working on right now: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/"]Dreadwoods Gatekeeper[/url]. It’s a story-driven medieval fantasy gatekeeping simulation with a horror theme (horror-themed, but not a jumpscare fest ːsteammockingː).[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The game focuses on a gatekeeping job simulation where you’ll manage the gate, inspect wagons, make decisions, and patrol the town. It’s a mystery-thriller story set in a small town filled with many characters. There’s also a touch of bow combat, which you’ll master alongside the protagonist. [/p][p]You’ll balance between upgrading your tools for gatekeeping and inspection, and getting better gear to protect yourself from wild animals and anything else that might lurk in the woods.[/p][p][/p][p]Note that the current trailer and screenshots are mostly placeholders. We’ve been working on the game for some time now, and soon we’ll update the page with a brand-new trailer soon.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31146872/d7fb264e15a8248bfcdd5ffe2b6f8999e7fadc26.gif"][/img][/p][p][i](A sneak peek at the characters we’ve been working on)[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p]Be sure to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/"]Wishlist and Follow the game[/url], or join our [url="https://discord.gg/RjXjQveAwZ"]Discord community[/url] to be among the first to try an early demo! [/p][p]I’d love to hear your feedback, which will help a ton in shaping the game.[/p][p][url=https://discord.gg/RjXjQveAwZ][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31146872/4c4cc6304d503a033e1217ce8e4094be1c96eb7e.png"][/img][/url]
